description: Optional cosmetic notifications. Inline fail-open launcher: missing runtime/files, errors and a 1-second process deadline never return blocking output or exit codes. macOS/POSIX only.

hooks.command: { if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -r "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/bridge.py" ]; then python3 -c 'import runpy, signal, sys; signal.alarm(1); path = sys.argv[1]; sys.argv = [path]; runpy.run_path(path, run_name="__main__")' "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/bridge.py"; fi; } >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
